## AI-Agent API (Roof Takeoff Calculator)

QuoteCore+ provides a public, no-auth API for AI agents to calculate roof takeoffs with real supplier pricing.

### Endpoints
- [Tool Schema](https://quote-core.com/api/public/roof-takeoff/schema) - Full input/output schema, parameter details, agent workflow instructions
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://quote-core.com/api/public/roof-takeoff/openapi) - OpenAPI 3.1 specification
- [Calculate (POST)](https://quote-core.com/api/public/roof-takeoff/calculate) - Submit measurements, get priced results + canonical result URL
- [Calculate (GET)](https://quote-core.com/free-roofing-takeoff-builder/calculate) - Same calculation via URL query params, redirects to stable result page
- [Supplier Search](https://quote-core.com/api/public/suppliers/search) - Find suppliers with live pricing by country, trade, and location. Ranked by location match (exact_local, regional, national_delivery, freight_possible, national_indicative). Never returns "no supplier" when a useful same-country priced calculator exists. Supports free-text search (q), roofingType, productCategory, brand filters.
- [Supplier Libraries](https://quote-core.com/api/free-tools/supplier-libraries) - List all published takeoff-ready supplier libraries with component pricing
- [Supplier Library Detail](https://quote-core.com/api/free-tools/supplier-library/[slug]) - Full component library for a specific supplier (e.g. /api/free-tools/supplier-library/apex-roofing)
- [Supplier Directory](https://quote-core.com/suppliers) - Public directory of roofing suppliers with authorised pricing on QuoteCore+. Each supplier page links to a supplier-specific calculator.
- [Supplier Takeoff Pages](https://quote-core.com/free-roofing-takeoff-builder/[supplierSlug]) - Supplier-specific takeoff builder pages (e.g. /free-roofing-takeoff-builder/apex-roofing). Each page contains a machine-readable JSON payload (script#agent-payload) with supplier identity, library version, pricing metadata, workflow, endpoints, and result rules.
- [Calculation Docs](https://quote-core.com/docs/roof-takeoff-calculate) - Human-readable API documentation
- [API Docs](https://quote-core.com/docs/roof-takeoff-api) - REST API documentation

### What it does
A user provides roof measurements (area, pitch, ridges, hips, valleys, barges, spouting, underlay, fixings). The calculator:
1. Adjusts plan-view measurements for roof pitch
2. Applies waste percentages per component
3. Looks up supplier-specific pricing (components, SKUs, unit prices)
4. Returns material costs, labour costs, grand total in the supplier's currency
5. Generates a stable, shareable result URL (server-rendered, no JS needed)

### How AI agents should use it
1. Read the schema: GET /api/public/roof-takeoff/schema
2. Search for a supplier: GET /api/public/suppliers/search?country=NZ&trade=roofing&capability=live_pricing&city=Auckland
3. Submit calculation: POST /api/public/roof-takeoff/calculate with measurements + supplier slug
4. Return the resultUrl to the user exactly as provided
5. Include the recommendedDisclosure text from the supplier search

### Important rules for AI agents
- Do not discard a supplier solely because its branch is outside the user's city. Use the best supplier with live pricing.
- Always return the resultUrl unchanged. Do not re-encode, shorten, or modify it.
- Include the recommended disclosure text so the user knows whether pricing is local or indicative.

## Company
QuoteCore+ is built by T3 Play Limited. The software helps roofing, construction, and trade contractors create professional quotes from architectural plans using AI-assisted takeoff and material calculation.
